content.title: About
content.content: Iced black tea in a bottle is a ready‑to‑drink beverage made from fully oxidized black tea leaves, cooled and sealed in a hermetic container. It offers a strong, slightly bitter flavor with a refreshing aroma, often lightly sweetened or flavored with fruit notes.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Black tea is the second most consumed tea worldwide after green tea.
Oxidation (fermentation) gives black tea its dark color and robust taste.
Bottled iced teas gained popularity in the early 2000s as an alternative to sodas.
Some manufacturers add vitamin C to boost antioxidant capacity.
Bottled tea is best stored below 25 °C to preserve flavor and prevent microbial growth.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Black tea contains polyphenols such as theaflavins and thearubigins that help neutralize free radicals.

items.title: Supports cardiovascular health
items.content: Moderate regular consumption may help lower LDL‑cholesterol levels.

items.title: Improves focus
items.content: Caffeine stimulates the central nervous system, enhancing alertness and concentration.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: As a liquid beverage, it contributes to daily fluid intake.

items.title: Aids digestion
items.content: Tannins can promote digestive comfort and reduce post‑meal heaviness.

items.title: Caffeine content
items.content: Excessive intake may cause nervousness, insomnia, and rapid heartbeat.

items.title: Tannins
items.content: High amounts can interfere with iron absorption from plant foods.

items.title: Added sugars
items.content: Some versions contain added sugar, increasing calories and risk of dental caries.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: To extend shelf life, preservatives may be used, which some consumers prefer to avoid.

content.title: How to Drink
content.content: Iced bottled tea is ready to drink straight from the bottle. It can be enjoyed on its own, used in cocktails, mixed with fruit juices, or served over ice with a slice of lemon.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the bottle in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, refrigerate and consume within 3–5 days, sealing the cap tightly.
